text: 3 panels were nice - one arrived late and-. one panel (needed four) arrived late and the stitches were plastic and sharp - they were loose and jaggered. Returned all 4 panels but a month later Amazon says some not received?! Sale was done by Amazon Services not Half Price Drapes. Not sure who sent defective pair. Since separate shipments the return is screwed up at Amazon. Had to call and they said "keep!" Keep? You got all four back! Errrrr! I keep UPS receipts about a month only.

product_metadata.title: HPD Half Price Drapes Heritage Plush Velvet Curtains for Bedroom & Living Room 50 X 96, VPYC-161252-96 (1 Panel) Dark Merlot
features: How To Hang: Our most versatile header allows you to hang 3 ways. Curtain panels can be sheered on a rod using the pocket, Hang with back tabs for a fixed ripple look or attached to rings using the belt and drapery pins. The Pole Pocket will accommodate a pole up to 1.5 inches in diameter, Hooks Not Included.

What You Get: Once purchased you will receive ONE PANEL (1), measuring 50 inches (127 cm) wide by 96 inches (243.84 cm) in length. Each panel will be individually bagged to preserve the fabric quality. Choose the right curtain length with our Measuring Guide, See below.

Light Control: This lined curtain panel is considered Room Darkening, blocking anywhere from 75-94.9% of the light. Darker colors will always block more of the light while lighter colors let more of the light through.
Color & Texture: This Dark Merlot color is a perfect choice for your home decor. This curtain is lined and is backed with smooth off-white fabric.
Keep It Clean: The curtains should be dry cleaned only. Fold lines can be steamed out using a iron or garment steamer. Avoid making contact with the face fabric.
description: Our polyester velvet fabric is soft and supple and perfect to achieve a casual elegance in any room. Suitable for curtains and light upholstery. 100Percent polyester. “The digital images we display have the most accurate color possible.
